title: Correct work sign interpretation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly interpret that work done against electrostatic force is negative work done by the electrostatic force.

title: Work addition for path
description: Important Criteria: Student must sum the work done by electrostatic force along the path A→B→C to find total work from A to C.

title: Potential difference calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly apply U = W/q with proper sign from the charge and work.

title: Sign error in final answer
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student obtains +2V instead of -2V due to incorrect sign handling of work or charge.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: Student verifies units (J/C = V) are consistent throughout calculation.

title: Path independence recognition
description: Important Criteria: Student recognizes electrostatic force is conservative, allowing work addition along any path.

title: Work against force misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student treats work against electrostatic force as positive in work summation.
